item.description: Redis contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the 'tlsProcessPendingData()' function, which handles the TLS pending-data list if Redis is configured with TLS support. A remote, unauthenticated attacker may be able to execute arbitrary commands wit…

item.title: CVE-2026-75498 · 8.6 HIGH — Webkul QloApps SQL injection
item.description: Webkul QloApps does not validate request parameters before a database query. A remote, authenticated attacker with administrative privileges could send a crafted SQL query to the 'bo_query' parameter in the 'Address.php' file. Fixed in 123c97c.

item.title: CVE-2026-75497 · 8.6 HIGH — Webkul QloApps SQL injection
item.description: Webkul QloApps does not validate request parameters before a database query. A remote, authenticated attacker with administrative privileges could send a crafted SQL query to the 'bo_query' parameter in the 'CustomerMessage.php' file. Fixed in 123c97…

item.title: CVE-2026-75496 · 8.6 HIGH — Webkul QloApps improper file upload validation
item.description: Webkul QloApps does not perform proper validation on uploaded file extensions or MIME types before moving the file to a publicly accessible directory. A remote, authenticated attacker with administrative privileges could upload executable files and a…

item.title: CVE-2026-75933 · 8.5 HIGH ☁️ — Jet Admin Stored XSS
item.description: Jet Admin allows an authenticated attacker to inject JavaScript via the sign-in page's scripts and styles option. Injected script is executed in the context of any visiting user's domain.

item.title: CVE-2026-75932 · 9.2 CRITICAL 🌩️ ☁️ — Jet Admin tenant isolation failure
item.description: Jet Admin allows an attacker to create a malicious app and connect it to a target user's custom domain, edit the authentication configuration, and reroute traffic to the attacker-controlled app. Once connected to the target domain, the attacker's wor…

item.title: CVE-2026-75928 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ ☁️ — Brushfire unauthenticated information disclosure
item.description: The Brushfire platform's video content streaming application (https://online.brushfire.com) exposes database path in requests to users, allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to read information about other users. Fixed February 2026.

item.title: CVE-2026-49114 · 7.1 HIGH — ONNX symlink-following and path-traversal arbitrary file write

item.title: CVE-2026-73669 · 7.3 HIGH 🌩️ — Signify Philips Hue Bridge Pro MQTT broker missing authentication
item.description: The Signify Philips Hue Bridge Pro firmware embeds a Mosquitto MQTT broker service that listens on all network interfaces without authentication. An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the MQTT service on a vulnerable system can read data…

item.title: CVE-2026-67180 · 8.4 HIGH — Google Turbinia arbitrary command execution
item.description: Google Turbinia allows arbitrary command execution via worker tasks. An attacker with privileges to submit a processing request or influence an evidence path/name obtains code execution on the worker fleet. Fixed on 2026-07-10.

item.title: CVE-2026-67179 · 7.8 HIGH — Genkit improper host header validation
item.description: Genkit does not properly validate host request headers. Any host on the developer's network, and any website the developer visits (via DNS rebinding), can reach POST /api/runAction on the Dev UI server (default port 4000) and execute any registered G…

item.title: CVE-2026-72900 · 7.1 HIGH — Metabase information exposure
item.description: Metabase allows an authenticated, low-privileged attacker to read the entire Metabase application database.

item.title: CVE-2026-72899 · 10 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Metabase SQL injection via public card or dashboard
item.description: Metabase allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject arbitrary SQL via a publicly shared card or dashboard that exposes a field-filter (dimension) parameter.

item.title: CVE-2026-72898 · 10 CRITICAL 💥 🌩️ — Metabase SQL injection via password reset endpoint
item.description: Metabase allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject arbitrary SQL via the '/reset_password' database endpoint and gain administrator access to the connected Metabase instance.

item.title: CVE-2026-49435 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Keysight IxChariot-related products stack-based buffer overflow
item.description: Keysight IxChariot Endpoint and associated products contain a stack-based buffer overflow. An unauthenticated remote attacker can send a specially crafted packet and execute arbitrary code with administrative privileges.

item.title: CVE-2017-20242 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Keysight IxChariot Endpoint stack-based buffer overflow
item.description: Keysight IxChariot Endpoint before 9.5.102 contains a stack-based buffer overflow. An unauthenticated remote attacker can send a specially crafted packet to crash the endpoint or potentially execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2017-20241 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Keysight IxChariot Endpoint heap-based buffer overflow
item.description: Keysight IxChariot Endpoint before 9.5.102 contains a heap-based buffer overflow. An unauthenticated remote attacker can send a specially crafted packet to crash the endpoint or potentially execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-61344 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Superior Court of California Hearing Reminder Service unauthenticated information disclosure
item.description: The Superior Court of California Hearing Reminder Service at https://www.hrs.courts.ca.gov exposes an API endpoint that returns court reminder records containing potentially sensitive information without authentication.

item.description: Allwinner H616 TV Box TV98 has ADB enabled and exposed to the network on production. An attacker could request for ADB authorization and gain root level privileges if the victim allows access.

item.description: The Webmin HTTP server (miniserv.pl) allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate any user with a configured SSL client certificate by sending a forged HTTP header. A remote attacker can spoof certificate DNs and authenticate as any user. Fixed in…

item.title: CVE-2026-56021 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Webmin information disclosure via regex pattern
item.description: Webmin allows unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of any file ending in .conf within module directories, due to a bypassable regex pattern.

item.title: CVE-2026-56022 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Webmin MFA bypass
item.description: Webmin accepts basic authentication without session cookies when an attacker provides the 'User-Agent: webmin' header, allowing bypass of additional MFA requirements. Fixed in 2.640.

item.title: CVE-2026-45557 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Technitium DNS Server excessive DNSSEC requests
item.description: Technitium DNS Server aggressively tries to fetch missing RRSIG records or mismatched DNSKEY records. An attacker in control of a domain can cause a vulnerable system to generate excessive network traffic. Fixed in 15.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-44159 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ 👻 — Tyler Identity Local (TID-L) default administrative credentials
item.description: Tyler Identity Local (TID-L) uses documented, default administrative credentials. Users are not required to change the credentials before deployment. TID-L has not been distributed since December 2020, and has not been supported since 2021.

item.title: CVE-2026-43510 · 5.9 MEDIUM — CISA manage.get.gov insecure portfolio administrative privileges
item.description: manage.get.gov is the .gov TLD registrar maintained by CISA. manage.get.gov allows an organization administrator to assign domain manager privileges for domains not already in another organization. Fixed in 1.176.0 on or around 2026-04-30.

item.title: CVE-2025-51846 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — CryptPad unbounded WebSocket frame flood
item.description: CryptPad 2025.3.1 allows unbounded WebSocket frame flood. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can significantly degrade or deny service for all users of a CryptPad instance. Fixed in 2026.2.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-35383 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Bentley Systems iTwin Platform exposed access token
item.description: Bentley Systems iTwin Platform exposed a Cesium ion access token in the source of some web pages. An unauthenticated attacker could use this token to enumerate or delete certain assets. As of 2026-03-27, the token is no longer present in the web page…

item.title: CVE-2026-33268 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Nanoleaf Lines unauthenticated firmware file store
item.description: Nanoleaf Lines 12.3.2 does not authenticate firmware file uploads. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can upload firmware files on the device and consume storage resources. Fixed in 12.3.6.

item.title: CVE-2025-60949 · 9.3 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Census CSWeb leaked configuration files
item.description: Census CSWeb 8.0.1 allows "app/config" to be reachable via HTTP in some deployments. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could send requests to configuration files and obtain leaked secrets. Fixed in 8.1.0 alpha.

item.title: CVE-2025-60948 · 5.1 MEDIUM — Census CSWeb stored XSS
item.description: Census CSWeb 8.0.1 allows stored cross-site scripting in user supplied fields. A remote, authenticated attacker could store malicious javascript that executes in a victim's browser. Fixed in 8.1.0 alpha.

item.title: CVE-2025-60947 · 8.8 HIGH — Census CSWeb arbitrary file upload
item.description: Census CSWeb 8.0.1 allows arbitrary file upload. A remote, authenticated attacker could upload a malicious file, possibly leading to remote code execution. Fixed in 8.1.0 alpha.

item.title: CVE-2025-60946 · 8.8 HIGH — Census CSWeb path traversal
item.description: Census CSWeb 8.0.1 allows arbitrary file path input. A remote, authenticated attacker could access unintended file directories. Fixed in 8.1.0 alpha.
